notices: Loop 'problem_loop' returns each item through the new node 'problem_draft_stripped', which strips the item's text as specVersion 30 did.
In 'snippets/intake_line.md', the read input.intake.value.reason now starts its own line, after a blank line: at specVersion 31 a markdown_block read stands alone on its line.

texts.explanation: loop-item-strip-node: a loop whose .content is read returns each item through a node the migration wrote, which strips the item's text as 30 trimmed it: that node's text is 31's alone, and it is the item's text trimmed (#1509, comment 7207709261, item 1, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-27 (a rendered node for each such loop's ret strips each item); part 10 §§ 1.2, 3.2)

loop-item-strip-node: a loop whose .content is read returns each item through a node the migration wrote, which strips the item's text as 30 trimmed it: that node's text is 31's alone, and it is the item's text trimmed (#1509, comment 7207709261, item 1, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-27 (a rendered node for each such loop's ret strips each item); part 10 §§ 1.2, 3.2)

block-read-own-line: a markdown_block read that had text beside it on its line, which 31 refuses, or a line of text next to its line, is separated from that text by a blank line the migration wrote: 31's text holds the line endings of that blank line where 30's has the read inside the line, or one line ending (#1543, ruling 2, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-27 (a markdown_block read separated from the text beside it by a blank line); part 10 §§ 1.2, 3.2)
